# 安全性說明 / Security

## 繁體中文

### 版本支援

安全性修正以最新正式版本為主。其他版本是否仍受支援，請以各版本說明為準。

### 私密回報問題

如發現可能影響安全或隱私的問題，請使用
[私密安全性回報頁面](https://github.com/yPinn/Utawakui-Releases/security/advisories/new)
與我們聯絡。請盡量附上使用版本、問題發生步驟與可能影響。

請勿在公開頁面或討論中揭露問題細節。

## English

### Supported Versions

Security fixes focus on the latest official release. Refer to each release's
notes to determine whether another version is still supported.

### Private Reporting

If you discover a possible security or privacy issue, contact us through the
[private security report page](https://github.com/yPinn/Utawakui-Releases/security/advisories/new).
Include the version you used, steps that reproduce the issue, and the possible
impact when available.

Do not disclose the details on a public page or in a public discussion.
